claims.assertion: Mari says physical negatives may be reinterpreted positively after death, while positives remain positive.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says interpretations vary; do not generalize.

claims.assertion: She says reluctance to reincarnate may change after death, when physical life seems temporary.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says experience, learning, and spiritual growth carry beyond death; possessions matter through experience.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She attributes repeated reincarnation to personal attachments, not coercive entities.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Letting go and forgiveness may help avoid repetition.

claims.assertion: She frames life as spiritual growth and creating paradise, urging perseverance and self-kindness.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
